ONE CALL, TWO WAYS

When a person picks up, and when the AI does.

A customer calls: “Do you have a 20 gram 22K bangle, what is today’s price, and how much is left on my scheme?”

A person picks up

  1. Puts the customer on hold
  2. Asks the stock room if the bangle is there
  3. Asks accounts for the scheme balance
  4. Checks today’s rate
  5. Calls the customer back, if they are free

Minutes to hours · 2 to 3 people Many customers hang up or buy elsewhere while waiting.

The AI picks up

  1. Knows the customer from the number
  2. Checks the bangle in live stock
  3. Reads today’s rate and the scheme balance
  4. Quotes the price and books a visit
  5. Sends photos and a payment link on WhatsApp

Seconds · nobody else needed Day or night, 8 callers at a time.

YOUR WORRIES, ANSWERED

Everything jewellers ask before switching it on.

“Will customers mind talking to AI?”

It speaks naturally, in their language, and gets them an answer in seconds. Anyone who wants a person is handed over at once.

“What if it says something wrong?”

It only answers from your live stock, rates and customer records, and only takes the actions you allow. It never negotiates price.

“Do I need new numbers or machines?”

No. It works on a phone line connected to Jwero. No hardware, nothing to install in the shop.

“Is it expensive?”

Charged per call. A call handled by hand ties up 2 to 3 people. Use the calculator above with your own numbers.

“Will it speak my customers’ language?”

Yes: Hindi, English, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi and Odia.

“Can I stop it or check what it said?”

Every call is recorded as a transcript on the customer’s record. One switch stops all calling.

“Is it allowed?”

Calls about a customer’s own account are fine. Promotional calls follow TRAI’s rules; we set this up with you.

“How long to start?”

Days, not months: connect the line, choose what it may do, write the scripts with us, switch on.

TRIGGERS AND CAMPAIGNS

Calls that place themselves.

Triggers: an instalment falling due, a failed payment, an unanswered WhatsApp message, a piece or repair ready, a customer’s anniversary. Each can place a call automatically, and if the call is not answered, a WhatsApp message follows.

Campaigns: choose a segment (scheme members due, customers who bought bridal last year, quiet customers in one city), a script, a language and a calling window. Watch answered, paid and booked as they happen.

WhatsApp in the same flow: the call and the chat share one record, so the payment link, catalogue or booking confirmation goes out the moment the customer says yes. WhatsApp API for jewellers →

HOW IT STAYS SAFE

Inside your rules, and the law’s.

Your rules: daily caps, calling hours, which actions the agent may take, and an approval queue for the actions you choose. One switch stops all calling.

The law’s: calls about a customer’s own account, such as reminders, are treated differently from promotional calls, which follow TRAI’s rules on registration, consent and do-not-disturb preferences. Tell customers calls are recorded. Read the AI calling guide →

What it will not do: negotiate prices or give discounts. Those go to a person. Calls run over a telephony line you connect, from your telephony provider.

HOW TO SET IT UP

How to set up AI calling for a jewellery shop.

Five steps, done with you.

  1. 1

    Connect a telephony line

    Link a number from your telephony provider. Calls run over this line and are charged per minute.

  2. 2

    Choose what the agent may do

    Answer questions, book visits, send links, remind about dues. Set daily caps, calling hours and when to hand over to a person.

  3. 3

    Write the scripts in your words

    Greeting, reminder and invitation scripts, in the languages your customers speak. Jwero drafts them with you.

  4. 4

    Set triggers and campaigns

    Calls that place themselves (instalment due, payment failed, piece ready) and campaigns to segments you choose.

  5. 5

    Go live and review

    Watch answered, paid and booked numbers, read transcripts, and adjust. One switch stops all calling.

QUESTIONS

What people ask before they message.

What is AI calling?

AI calling means a voice AI agent makes and answers phone calls for a business: it speaks naturally, understands spoken replies, follows a script and the rules you set, and records the outcome. For jewellers that means scheme reminders, follow-ups, invitations and answering enquiries without a team of telecallers.

What is a voice AI agent?

A voice AI agent is software that holds a real phone conversation: it listens, understands, answers from what it knows about the customer and your shop, takes actions like booking a visit or sending a payment link, and hands over to a person when needed.

Can AI make bulk calls to customers?

Yes. Jwero handles up to 8 calls at the same time, inbound and outbound. It runs calling campaigns in bulk, for example every scheme member whose instalment is due this week, and answers several callers at once so nobody gets a busy tone in the festival rush.

Can AI answer calls for my jewellery shop?

Yes. The voice agent answers rate, timing, stock and order questions, books visits, and passes the call to a person with a summary when the customer needs one, including after hours.

Can calls happen automatically when something happens?

Yes. Triggers place calls on events such as an instalment falling due, a failed payment, an unanswered WhatsApp message or a repair being ready. If a call is not answered, a WhatsApp message can follow.

Which languages does the voice agent speak?

The phone agent speaks your customers’ languages, including Hindi, English, Tamil, Bengali, Arabic, Spanish and French, so each customer can be called in the language they speak at home.

Is AI calling legal in India?

Calls to your own customers about their account, such as scheme reminders, are treated differently from promotional calls. Promotional calls must follow TRAI’s rules on registration, consent and do-not-disturb preferences. Confirm your setup with your advisor before calling at scale.

How much does AI calling cost?

The AI agent costs Charged per call, all inclusive: the AI, the voice and the phone line, from a prepaid wallet. A call handled by hand usually takes 2 to 3 people several minutes each, so Charged per call is far cheaper. It runs on Jwero One on one plan, or let Jwero run the calling for you.

Why is an AI call faster than a person picking up?

When a person answers, they often have to ask 2 or 3 colleagues for the stock, the rate or the customer’s balance, then call back. The AI agent reads all of that from the customer’s record and the live catalogue, and answers, books or sends a link within seconds, at any hour.

Will the AI negotiate prices or give discounts?

No. Price negotiation and discounts go to a person. The agent works only inside the actions, caps and hours you allow, and one switch stops all calls.
